name: Securities Account Deletion Request V 01
definition: The SecuritiesAccountDeletionRequest message is sent by an instructing party to the executing party to request for the deletion of a securities account from the securities account reference data defined in the system of the executing party.||Usage: |It aims at instructing the deletion of an existing securities account providing securities account identification.|The result of the deletion is provided through a SecuritiesAccountStatusAdvice message.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Common business identification for the message.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Identification of the securities account to be deleted from the executing party system.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
